vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: ceo
Version: 1.0.2

The skill bundle consists entirely of markdown files providing comprehensive guidance and frameworks for an AI agent to act as a Chief Executive Officer. The content across all files (`SKILL.md`, `board.md`, `decisions.md`, `operations.md`, `strategy.md`) is purely informational and advisory, focusing on business strategy, leadership, and management principles. There are no executable commands, network calls, file system operations, or prompt injection attempts designed to make the agent deviate from its stated purpose or perform any malicious actions.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only CEO advisory skill whose files and runtime instructions match its stated purpose and it requests no credentials, binaries, or installs.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (CEO guidance: strategy, board, hiring, crisis) align with the included files (strategy.md, board.md, decisions.md, operations.md). The skill does not request unrelated env vars, binaries, or config paths.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the companion docs contain prescriptive guidance for executive decisions. There are no instructions to read system files, environment variables, network endpoints, or to transmit data externally. The skill explicitly marks many decisions as human-in-the-loop, which is appropriate for high-risk CEO actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files to execute. Being instruction-only means nothing is written to disk or fetched at install time.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables, credentials, or config paths are declared. The guidance does not reference any secrets or external service tokens, so requested access is proportionate.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and model invocation is allowed (default). Autonomous invocation is the platform default and is not, by itself, a concern here because the skill lacks elevated privileges, installs, or credential access.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally coherent and contains only advisory documentation for executive decision-making. Before installing: (1) note the source is unknown and there is no homepage—if provenance matters, prefer skills from known authors; (2) treat recommendations as advisory, not authoritative—verify high-stakes actions (layoffs, fundraising, M&A, exec terminations) with qualified humans/legal/financial counsel; (3) consider keeping human-in-the-loop enforcement for any actions the agent might propose, and monitor or limit autonomous invocation if you do not want the agent to act without explicit confirmation.
